cohort: all original E1 assessment rows, historically consumed
universe: E4's fixed 2453 dictionary-matched classes intersected with original published native masks
probability_calibration: reuse frozen E4 parameters; no optimization
reliability_head: one deterministic reconstruction of E4 HGB on original 1061 risk-calibration rows; require reproduction of frozen NEON policy
mask_rule: ceil(dose * distinct positive eligible genera) per cell; zero dose and zero-positive cells unchanged; weighted exponential-race sampling without replacement; same cell/seed uniforms across arms and nested doses
genus_weights: inverse square root of median training-only relative_prevalence among fixed-universe species in genus, floored at 1e-6; zero assessment-prevalence use
censoring: hide all eligible positive AND negative species labels in selected genera; never restore oracle positives; species identity fully censored
development_criterion: at 20% dose, either scoring treatment has absolute seed-mean F1 bias >=.01 with its paired spatial interval wholly outside [-.01,.01] in BOTH mechanisms; report paired-contrast distortions separately, without claiming they must occur
